blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Rank counts only communities with at least ten homes listed. Falling listings with steady sales mean homes are being absorbed faster; rising listings with steady sales mean more choice for buyers. A sellers’ best bet is a community where homes sell quickly against the number listed; a buyers’ best bet is the reverse. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Between June 2026 and October 2026, detached houses: listings fell from 137 in June to 122 in October (−10.9%), and it took 14.0% of the city’s 464 sales over the period; condos and townhomes: listings was little changed, 143 in June and 141 in October (−1.4%), and it took 11.4% of the city’s 737 sales over the period.
The monthly write-ups singled out Fleetwood Tynehead for condos and townhomes in August (a sellers’ best bet); condos and townhomes in July (a buyers’ best bet).

blocks.text: Lots and land in Fleetwood Tynehead
What trades here

items.t: Urban lot fabric: No typical lot size, lot count or lot price is stated as a sub-area profile — none is documented on an official source.

East-end acreage fabric: a feed card for a 94a Avenue acreage cites a 2024 City drainage infrastructure report for Anniedale-Tynehead — listing text only, not verified. The plan area runs toward the ALR in the east, so east-end parcels carry plan, drainage and reserve checks that standard Fleetwood lots do not.

Fee-simple lots are the default form: a detached house lot or a vacant infill lot here is fee-simple unless title says otherwise — no strata corporation, no Form B, no strata fees. A sub-area-wide strata-versus-freehold split is not verified.

: a bare-land strata lot is strata tenure on the lot itself — Form B, strata fees and registered bylaws apply; it is not fee-simple. No bare-land strata plan inside Fleetwood Tynehead was verified — no such plan is named or counted, and tenure on any specific parcel is a title question.
Built stock — cross-reference only, never land

Assemblies / development sites / rezoning proposals, documented as such, never as inventory: none is documented as a named proposal in this sub-area's research. The Fleetwood Plan itself (Stage 1 endorsed Mar 7, 2022, updated Stage 1 endorsed Oct 16, 2023, further Transit Oriented Areas alignment changes since, Council to consider the updated plan in 2026) is a plan process, not a development site and not land inventory — and until the updated plan is considered, a lot's future designation near the town centre / stations is not settled.

ALR vs non-ALR split: no split is published and no specific sub-area parcel result is documented — none is stated. The east end runs toward the ALR; check any east-end parcel on the ALC maps by PID or civic address.
: No phase selling vacant lots is documented in this sub-area. Never mixed with built presales.

items.t: That count is a snapshot, not a market statistic. (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report)

Municipal geography: the City's Fleetwood Plan guides growth over the next 30+ years in Fleetwood as SkyTrain extends along Fraser Highway, with a plan area stretching from Green Timbers Urban Forest in the west towards the Agricultural Land Reserve in the east; the Anniedale-Tynehead ground at the east end is planned under its own separately named City plan process.

Schools (Ministry-listed names and addresses only): Fleetwood Park Secondary, 7940 156 St; William Watson Elementary, 16450 80 Ave; Walnut Road Elementary, 16152 82 Ave; Coast Meridian Elementary, 8222 168a St; Frost Road Elementary, 8606 162 St; Woodland Park Elementary, 9025 158 St; Bothwell Elementary, 17070 102 Ave, at the north edge by address.

Transit — stations named, not operating: Fleetwood Station at the northeast corner of 160 Street and Fraser Highway, and Bakerview-166 Street Station at the northwest corner of 166 Street and Fraser Highway with an integrated transit exchange, on the 16-kilometre Surrey Langley SkyTrain extension from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City.
No Metro Vancouver park page was opened, so its size, trails and hatchery details are not verified here.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: Fleetwood Plan status: the plan will guide growth over the next 30+ years as SkyTrain extends along Fraser Highway; Stage 1 was endorsed Mar 7, 2022, an updated Stage 1 was endorsed Oct 16, 2023, further changes have been made to align with the Province's Transit Oriented Areas legislation, and Council will consider the updated plan in 2026 — confirm current zoning and plan status with the City before quoting density for a lot.

ALR block (applies at the east end where ALR ground exists): subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval; ALR residences cannot be stratified (ALC Bulletin 09 s.6; SPA s.239; ALCA s.21(1)); caps: principal ≤500 m², suite within principal only, additional residence 90 m² (≤40 ha) / 186 m² (>40 ha). Farm class is three-tier — $2,500 on 0.8–4 ha / $2,500 + 5% of value over 4 ha / $10,000 under 0.8 ha, applications by Oct 31 — a flat "$2,500+" line is an error, and no farm-class claim is asserted for this sub-area.

blocks.text: Good to know about Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: Station proximity is a plan fact, not a service.

Established Fleetwood lots turn on zone and plan status; Tynehead-side acreages add ALR-edge, Anniedale-Tynehead plan and drainage questions. A price case built on west-end comparables does not answer east-end questions.

Small plan wording, real consequence: the Fleetwood Plan area "stretches towards" the ALR — that does not make a Fleetwood lot an ALR lot, and it does not exempt an ALR-edge parcel from the ALC frame. Reserve status is read parcel by parcel, never inferred from the plan's direction of travel.

blocks.text: Mobile and manufactured homes in Fleetwood Tynehead
No bare-land strata manufactured-home community and no co-op is verified inside this sub-area.
The parks and communities

items.t: Westwood Court: Plainly: a home here sits on a rented pad — the buyer owns the home (a chattel) and rents the pad; the buyer does not own the land. There is no strata lot, no strata fee and no Form B — the tenancy is governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act and the park's own rules, not the Strata Property Act.

Westwood at Tynehead Park: Despite the shared "Westwood" name it has nothing to do with the pad-rental park at 8670 156 St: one gives you a Form B and a strata lot, the other gives you a pad tenancy agreement.

RV parks / campgrounds: none is named as a manufactured-home park for Fleetwood Tynehead in any source checked, and none is treated as one here — an RV park is not a manufactured-home park unless a source establishes year-round manufactured-home tenure, and no source does for Fleetwood Tynehead. Not confirmed / none found.

blocks.text: Streets, schools and getting around Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: FVREB publishes no public street-level sub-area boundary, and neither City plan area is stated to equal the board line: the street-level board boundary and the plan-area split are not verified.

Planning frame: the Fleetwood Plan will guide growth over the next 30+ years as SkyTrain extends along Fraser Highway; the Stage 1 Plan was endorsed March 7, 2022 and updated October 16, 2023, with further Transit Oriented Areas alignment changes and Council consideration of the updated plan in 2026 — a lot's future designation is a moving target until then.

Transit — SkyTrain coming, not operating: the Surrey Langley SkyTrain project's two stations serving this ground directly are Fleetwood Station (northeast corner of 160 Street and Fraser Highway) and Bakerview-166 Street Station (northwest corner of 166 Street and Fraser Highway, with an integrated transit exchange), on the 16-kilometre Expo Line extension from King George Station to 203 Street in Langley City.

Where the park sits: Westwood Court is on 156 Street, the west-side seniors street — the Evergreen Hamlets (8382 156 St) and the Elim Village campus on 159 Street sit on or just off the same corridor, while the 83 Avenue seniors cluster sits a few blocks east.

blocks.text: Good to know about Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: Two Westwoods, opposite tenures: Westwood at Tynehead Park (9652 162A St) is a strata townhouse complex built 2022–2023 by Vesterra; Westwood Court (8670 156 St) is the 55+ pad-rental park.

Surrey's tenant-protection bylaw does not cover the sub-area's park: Bylaw No. 21788 (2025) expressly does not apply to property governed by the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act — Westwood Court residents' redevelopment protection is the provincial framework plus the City's Manufactured Home Park Policy (12 months' notice of a final moving date, only after all permits are received, and $20,000 payable on or before the move-out date).

What a duplex looks like in Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: The usual duplex form: Parcel-by-parcel zoning is confirmed in cosmos / the consolidated bylaw before any duplex claim is made for a specific lot.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect duplexes in Fleetwood Tynehead

items.t: Secondary suites inside a duplex (Surrey rule): One secondary suite is permitted per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit; a suite is not permitted within a coach house or garden suite; and a suite's habitable floor area may not exceed 40% of the principal dwelling unit. Coach houses / garden suites: All Surrey residential zones that allow detached houses, duplexes and houseplexes also allow one; 35–75 m², rising to 120 m² for lots zoned RA, R2, R2-O and R3 where the existing house or duplex is below maximum FAR; smaller R3–R6 lots require lane access for a coach house; one extra parking space is required. East-end lots additionally need an ALR check: The plan area runs toward the ALR in the east, and on ALR parcels the ALC frame is one principal residence at a maximum of 500 m² plus at most one additional residence of 90 m² (parcels ≤40 ha) or 186 m² (parcels >40 ha).

Servicing / items: Transit frame: The Surrey Langley SkyTrain project names Fleetwood Station (northeast corner of 160 Street and Fraser Highway) and Bakerview-166 Street Station (northwest corner of 166 Street and Fraser Highway, integrated transit exchange) among its eight stations on the 16-km Expo Line extension from King George Station to Langley City — project stations, not operating service; the in-service date was not stated on the stations page read and is not verified.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: streets and boundaries

items.t: Fleetwood Town Centre is centred at Fraser Highway and 160 Street and 84 Avenue.
The Town Centre planning area is bounded by 88 Avenue north, 80 Avenue south, 156 Street west and 168 Street east.
Fleetwood is a designated Urban Centre in Metro Vancouver's Regional Growth Strategy (RGS).
Tynehead is the eastern part of the guide area toward 168 Street and Tynehead Regional Park; the City plan name for the whole area is Fleetwood.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: the housing stock

items.t: Areas close to planned SkyTrain stations are expected by the City to redevelop quicker than areas farther away.
The Fleetwood Plan will provide a vision for more than 25 years, and the City states some areas may not redevelop at all.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A new Fleetwood Plan is in preparation to guide growth over the next 30 years as SkyTrain extends on Fraser Highway; Step 4 engagement has concluded and the City is completing the plan.
The City states it would not redevelop a property itself; the plan shows what the City would support when an owner proposes redevelopment, with owner consent.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Fleetwood Station is described by the project as serving a community centre with library and gym facilities plus local retail at 160 Street.
160 Street between 88 Avenue and 96 Avenue is planned for widening as a short-term priority, anticipated 2026-2027, with timelines subject to change.
No timelines have been determined for 156 Street improvements, per the City's Fleetwood Plan answers.
Early SkyTrain construction preparation has started in Fleetwood and will ramp up; the Province offers construction updates by email signup.
Fleetwood Park Secondary is one of six Surrey secondaries on an extended-day schedule to manage enrolment, and funding for a Fleetwood Park addition has been announced.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: development and new projects

items.t: All eight stations were under construction by May 2026, with more than 30 percent of the elevated guideway complete, per the Province.
The Fleetwood Plan itself is the area-plan item for this guide: Step 4 engagement concluded, City completing the plan.

blocks.text: Fleetwood / Tynehead: getting around

items.t: Fraser Highway is the transit spine: the extension runs on it from King George Station through Fleetwood to Langley City Centre.
The project includes 14 kilometres of new separated multi-use pathways connecting to stations, per the federal-provincial release.
Until opening in late 2029, Fraser Highway remains a bus corridor; station-area bus routes will change when the line opens.

items.t: Check any lot near a station against the draft Fleetwood Plan land-use concept before assuming a future use; the plan is not yet complete.
Construction on Fraser Highway is active for the SkyTrain guideway, so access and frontage on that corridor need a current check with the project.

faq.q: Is Fleetwood Tynehead one neighbourhood or two?
faq.a: One board sub-area; the City plans the ground under the Fleetwood Plan (Green Timbers in the west towards the ALR in the east), with the Tynehead / Anniedale-Tynehead name at its east end under its own plan process.

faq.q: Can I buy a vacant building lot here?
faq.a: Yes as individual listings, not as a named subdivision — the feed carries R3-zoned land cards marketed for duplex and single-family builds. Each is checked parcel by parcel in COSMOS for zone, plan status and servicing; no named lot development is verified.

faq.q: What does R3 on a land card actually allow?
faq.a: R3 is the current (post-Jul 8, 2024) name for the former RF / RF-SS zones. Unit counts still run through the SSMUH bands (3–4 by lot size, up to 6 near a frequent bus stop) and the zone text in Bylaw 12000 — the card's "duplex potential" wording is listing text until the City confirms it for that parcel.

faq.q: Can I subdivide, or build multiple units instead?
faq.a: Different permissions: SSMUH does not create new lots; subdivision must meet the zone minimum in Bylaw No. 12000 and servicing under Bylaw No. 8830, confirmed with the City per parcel.

faq.q: How settled is the Fleetwood Plan for a lot near Fraser Highway?
faq.a: Not fully — Stage 1 was endorsed in 2022 and updated in 2023, Transit Oriented Areas changes followed, and Council was to consider the updated plan in 2026. Price current zoning, and treat future designation as unconfirmed until the updated plan is considered.

faq.q: In Westwood Court, do I own the land?
faq.a: No. You own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad — the park owns the land, and your right to the site is the assigned pad tenancy under the Manufactured Home Park Tenancy Act. Plainly, a home on a rented pad is not land ownership. There is no strata lot and no Form B.

faq.q: Is Westwood Court the same as Westwood at Tynehead Park?
faq.a: No — opposite tenures sharing a name. One gives you a pad tenancy agreement, the other a Form B and a strata lot.

faq.q: What do I pay each month in Westwood Court?
faq.a: Pad rent under the tenancy agreement, plus the home's property tax and insurance — there are no strata fees because there is no strata. The current figure for a specific pad is not confirmed: confirm it, what it includes, and the increase history for the exact site with the park before offering.

A park's age rule lives in its park rules and tenancy documents, not in a strata bylaw, so the written park rules are the deciding document — get the park's current rule in writing, including how a younger spouse is treated (in a park that is governed by the park's own rules, not the strata spouse exemption).

faq.q: Can I buy "half" of a Fleetwood Tynehead duplex?
faq.a: Only if the pair was legally split — either a 2-lot strata plan (each half a strata lot, Form B diligence) or a fee-simple subdivision (each half on its own lot). An undivided duplex sells whole, building and lot together.

faq.q: Can a duplex unit in Surrey have a secondary suite?
faq.a: One suite per duplex dwelling unit, at most 40% of the principal unit's habitable floor area, never inside a coach house or garden suite.
